sections.p: These terms govern the use of AltyDetect (altydetect.com), an online rewriting and writing assistance service published by [COMPANY NAME].
A trial without an account is available. Ongoing use requires an account, created with an email sign-in link or with Google.

Pro is a monthly or yearly subscription, paid in advance through Stripe. There is no commitment and you can cancel at any time from the Account page; it stays active until the end of the paid period. [REFUND AND WITHDRAWAL TERMS TO BE DEFINED].
The service improves the style, register and clarity of your texts. You remain responsible for the texts you submit and how you use them. A fair-use limit applies to the Pro plan.
Suggestions are generated automatically and must be reviewed. Detection results, once available, will be probabilities, not proof.
[GOVERNING LAW, JURISDICTION AND CONSUMER MEDIATOR TO BE DEFINED].

The texts you submit are processed in memory and then deleted. Only results (suggestions, corrections, outlines, summaries) are saved in your history. The original text is kept only if you ask for it.
History: 7 days on the Free plan, 12 months with Pro, then automatic deletion. Account: until you delete it, which you can do at any time from the Account page.
Your texts are never used to train a model unless you tick the corresponding option in your account yourself. It is off by default.

Hosting: [HOSTING PROVIDER]. Payments: Stripe. Sign-in emails: Resend. Sign-in with Google: Google. Rewriting and writing assistance: Anthropic (Claude API). [TRANSFERS OUTSIDE THE EU AND SAFEGUARDS TO BE SPECIFIED].
You have the rights of access, rectification, erasure, restriction, objection and portability. Write to [CONTACT EMAIL]. You can also contact the CNIL (cnil.fr).
AltyDetect only uses necessary cookies: sign-in session, interface language and the no-account trial. No advertising or analytics cookies.
[COMPANY NAME], [LEGAL FORM] with a share capital of [CAPITAL], registered under number [REGISTRATION NUMBER], head office: [ADDRESS]. Contact: [CONTACT EMAIL].
